messages:
Morgan: Quick handoff for the model-catalog sprint — onboarding three open models: fenris-13b, alder-lite-3b, ember2-7b. Need final license signoff + perf profiles by EOD Wed. Owners: Arjun (fenris perf), Liz (alder licensing), Sophie (ember canary). Ping me for blockers.
Arjun: Acknowledged. I'll run latency + throughput passes on p4d. Plan: latency bench batch=1 seq=2048; throughput batch=8 seq=512, quant=4-bit. ETA Tue EOD.
Liz: On alder-lite-3b licensing — tagging @Claudia for legal review. Also need model card fields populated: training_data, eval_sets, license_text.
Claudia (legal): Quick read — alder-lite shows AGPL-derived weights. That requires a copyleft notice in the model card and internal compliance tag. Liz, can you draft the disclosure? I can sign off Tue morning.
Sophie: I'll own ember2-7b canary + rollout config. Quick Q: what's our canonical baseline batch/seq for canary perf metrics? @Arjun
Arjun: Use batch=8, seq=512 for the throughput baseline. Latency baseline: batch=1, seq=2048. I'll upload perf profiles to /catalog/artifacts when done.
Morgan: Dependency check: eng-platform to confirm kernel builds and the 4-bit path on p4d. @Shaun any blocker patches?
Shaun (eng-platform): No blockers blocking launch. There's one small kernel tweak for improved 4-bit throughput — PR will land tomorrow morning. I'll drop the link here when ready.
Dimitri (catalog-bot): Reminder: Attach perf profiles to the intake thread using `/catalog upload <PERF_ID>` or the web UI.
Liz: Also: embeddings shape check for alder-lite — does it do pooled CLS or only token-level? Need to know for embeddings API. @Sophie
Sophie: Alder returns token-level vectors only; we'll add a pooling transform in the serving shim to return pooled embeddings. I'll include the shim snippet in the artifact.
Morgan: Can someone review the small CR for license metadata extraction at `catalog/ingest/filters.py`? It just extracts license_text and adds a compliance tag. @Arjun @Liz
Arjun: I'll review after my perf runs finish. Expect review by 15:00.
Liz: Looking now — left one inline about AGPL field wording. Once that's updated I'll approve. :+1:
Morgan: Thanks. Launch milestone doc updated with a short checklist (internal link): https://rwd.internal/docs/catalog/launch-plan — please review the rollout dates.
Shaun (eng-platform): PR posted for the kernel tweak: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/412 — CI passing on linux-x64, will validate p4d patch run tomorrow.
Claudia (legal): Looping legal ops — no showstoppers, just the disclosure + internal compliance tag. I'll add comments to the intake form and upload a compliance checklist.
Morgan: If we have no licensing/perf blocks by EOD Wed we freeze intake and schedule canaries next week. Thanks everyone — if anything urgent please DM. :rocket:
